headline: NLC India Limited: Agreements
sum: Agreements - NLC India Limited hassigned a Joint Venture Agreement with National Aluminium Company Limited to incorporate a Joint Venture Company (JVC) for development of a 4×270 MW (1,080 MW) Coal based Thermal Captive Power Plant at…
detail: Agreements - NLC India Limited hassigned a Joint Venture Agreement with National Aluminium Company Limited to incorporate a Joint Venture Company (JVC) for development of a 4×270 MW (1,080 MW) Coal based Thermal Captive Power Plant at Angul, Odisha to meet the captivepower requirement of NALCO's 0.5 MTPA Aluminium Smelter Expansion Project.
